correctness.rationale: For n≥2, the intrinsic scale-two cube Čech faces are subsets of radius-one closed neighborhoods, not Vietoris–Rips. Adams–Shukla–Singh Theorem 4.1 supplies H2 concentration of rank 2^(n−2)(n²−3n+4)−1. Hopf trace counts fixed vertices F(g), fixed and swapped weight-1/2 edges with D=a1+C(a1,2)+a2 and τ(g), and higher fixed faces by their unique centers. This derives the full affine character F(1−D/2+C(a1,2)−a2)+2^(r−1)τ−1, uniformly in n; averaging translations gives character C(a1,2)−a2 on H2^T, precisely ∧² of the permutation module. Each transposition negates its indexed alternating pair, so no full-group invariants. Independent code computed all group elements for n=2..5 and agreed; not used for the all-n theorem.

originality.rationale: The 2022/2025 Adams–Shukla–Singh homotopy theorem fixes only homology dimension, and the separately published translation-only SCOPE representation fixes only T_n restriction. Neither determines S_n coordination or the full semidirect-product character; the explicit τ(g) correction and the S_n-module ∧²Q^n are additional. Galetto–Montaño–Wellner analyze a different Vietoris–Rips complex. Best-of-knowledge originality; no claim of complete full-group irreducible decomposition.
